_comment: Single source of truth for HyperFrames scene templates. Consumed by both the Node engine (hyperframes_engine/) via require() and the Python backend (backend/app/services/visual_learning/) via json.load(). Add/remove/edit a template here instead of editing prompt files or hardcoded lists directly - every consumer derives its behavior from this file. 'status' controls whether the LLM is offered the template: active = offered, banned = deliberately excluded (see 'banned_reason'), fallback_only = never offered to the LLM but used internally as an engine fallback, experimental = offered but flagged as unproven.

column_comparison.best_for: Comparing two items, pros/cons, side-by-side contrast

horizontal_timeline.banned_reason: Not currently offered in production prompt; drifted out of the template-choice list at some point. No known rendering defect - candidate to re-enable after a quick visual QA pass.

database_grid.best_for: Structured tabular data, elements, properties, numeric tables

before_after_slider.best_for: State changes, cause vs effect, transformations

quiz_checkpoint.banned_reason: Product decision: lessons should end with a structural summary, not a quiz interruption, per current pedagogy rules.

illustrated_scene.best_for: SVG-drawn scene of a physical/process/anatomical concept (e.g. water cycle with sun+sea+rising vapor, a stomach digesting, a plant cell, a historical scene) - the one template that draws real pictorial content instead of text-in-boxes; prefer this whenever the concept is something students would picture visually
illustrated_scene.template_data_hint: {"title": "...", "animation_action": "rise|fall|spin|scale_up|slide_left|slide_right" (how the drawn elements animate in), "elements": [{"type": "path|circle|line|rect", "path_data": "SVG path 'd' attribute, required for type=path", "cx": 0, "cy": 0, "r": 0 (for type=circle), "stroke_color": "#hex", "stroke_width": 2, "fill": "rgba(r,g,b,a)" or "none", "dash_array": "8 6" (optional, for flowing/moving lines like rising vapor or arrows), "label": "optional short text overlay for this element"}]}. MUST include at least 4-8 elements combining: an outline/shape (path), 1-2 moving/highlight accents (small circles), and flow indicators (dashed lines) to draw a recognizable, non-lazy scene - e.g. for the water cycle: a sun (circle), wavy sea (path), 2-3 rising dashed lines for evaporation, a cloud shape (path or grouped circles), and falling lines for rain.

image_scene.banned_reason: Requires a real image asset pipeline (image_url sourcing) not yet wired up end-to-end.

general_scene.best_for: Free-form fallback only - not a deliberate LLM choice
general_scene.fallback_reason: Used internally by normalizeTemplateId() when an LLM-provided template_id doesn't match any known template. Never offer this to the LLM as a selectable option - if it starts appearing in generated lessons, that indicates a template_id normalization bug, not a valid scene choice.
